facts.fact: The policy sets itself over the next five years, 2019 to 2024, with a mid-term review at year 3 and a long-term review in year 5.
facts.system: Liberia Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Policy (2019-2024)

facts.fact: The full policy text is held on the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications website (mopt.gov.lr), published 2019-10-31.
facts.system: Liberia Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Policy (2019-2024)

facts.fact: The policy carries a summary of measurable targets with timelines of years 1 to 5 after adoption, and no cost figures appear in the passages read.
facts.system: Liberia Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Policy (2019-2024)

facts.fact: The policy assigns the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications overall coordination, implementation, review and oversight, with the LTA, an ICT Governing Board, a cross-ministerial CIO Council and a CIO to the Presidency supporting.
facts.system: Liberia Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Policy (2019-2024)

facts.fact: The passages read tie the policy to no budget line; the Executive is said only to ensure resources are available to the requisite ministries.
facts.system: Liberia Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Policy (2019-2024)

facts.fact: The document states that the National ICT and Telecoms policy of 2010 was adopted by Cabinet under the Telecommunications Act of 2007, and that the 2019-2024 policy updates and amends it.

note: The document does not state its own adoption date or adopting act in the passages read, so no standing fact is recorded for the 2019-2024 policy itself.
